Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot

Class LootDrops

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot.LootDrops
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener
public final class LootDrops extends Object implements EventListener
Drops an item of the loot table where an enemy dies (GDD 1.4); the table makes rare items drop less often.

    • LootDrops

      public LootDrops(LootTable table, ItemDropper dropper, RandomSource random, double chance)
      Creates the loot rule.
      Parameters:
      table - picks the item, weighted by rarity
      dropper - puts the item on the ground
      random - rolls the drop and the item
      chance - the chance an enemy drops something, from 0 to 1
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an object is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the chance is outside 0 to 1
